title: BEST INFINITE MOB XP FARM MINECRAFT 1.21! Bedrock MCPE/Xbox/PS4/Nintendo Switch/Windows 10
description:
In this video, I will show you how to make the next generation of infinite multi-based versions of all mob farms in one just by using a composter and water and using that to push mobs over all layers without using anything else in Minecraft!

If you enjoyed this channel, it will focus on high-performance and simple farms that are beyond levels of bedrock so be sure to turn on the notification to be notified!
